correction.statement: From 1.12.6 to 1.13.0 the storage version of updaterequests.kyverno.io changes from v1beta1 to v2. v1beta1 is still served, so existing UpdateRequest objects keep working and stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten. No breakage or mandatory step is stated for this release.

consequence.statement: New or rewritten UpdateRequest objects are stored as v2, while existing objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten. v1beta1 is still served, so nothing stops working in this release.
consequence.remediation: Optional: rewrite existing UpdateRequest objects so they are stored as v2, and check the CRD's status.storedVersions. Do this before any future release that removes v1beta1.
